risks.detail: This lane has build/lint proof, but not in-browser visual QA. Hierarchy, density, and contrast should still be eyeballed against the live Settings surface before merge.

frontend/src/styles/style.css was already dirty before this lane. The file-level git diff includes unrelated work, so merge review should isolate the Garmin-specific selectors added around the Settings atlas and Garmin modal blocks.

mustPreserve: Keep the surrounding Settings command-center structure intact.
Keep manual import visible as the fallback path.
Preserve real Garmin form behavior and import wiring.
Keep the result dual-mode safe for dark and light families.
Do not touch JSX files from this lane.
mergeNotes: New Garmin selectors were added late in style.css so they override the older border-heavy Garmin utility styles without rewriting unrelated selectors.

The atlas changes are scoped to Garmin-only classes such as settings-atlas-garmin-cluster, settings-atlas-service-card--garmin, settings-atlas-import-drop--garmin, and related service/meta/state selectors.
The modal changes are scoped to garmin-import-modal-shell/card, garmin-import-layout, garmin-import-visual/panel, garmin-import-stage, garmin-import-pill variants, and related field/action selectors.
Responsive fallbacks were added for the Garmin lane and modal only.
